title: Uniform-in-Time Weak and Ergodic Error Estimates of a Nonlinearity-Explicit Full Discretization for Superlinear SPDEs Driven by Multiplicative Noise
summary: For a class of superlinear SPDEs driven by multiplicative noise, we prove an (essentially) sharp uniform-in-time (UIT) weak convergence rate for the nonlinearity-explicit Galerkin tamed Euler method (GTEM). Under standard monotonicity assumptions, the proof combines Malliavin calculus with regularity theory for the associated backward Kolmogorov equation (BKE), leading to UIT moment, Hölder, and Malliavin estimates, along with regularity estimates for the BKE solution.
